column4: Visit note | 2025-11-09 03:00 PM | Dr. Nazma Begum, Obstetrics and Gynecology | Patient: Priya Paul, 27, female. Mrs. Paul attends for review regarding ongoing weight gain and irregular periods. She is a fisherman and mentioned she first noticed these changes after a friend in Farmgate suggested testing her hormone levels. She reports her breathing is stable regarding her Bronchial asthma and she has no acute wheezing today. She denies severe abdominal pain, chest discomfort, or unexpected dizziness. On examination: BMI 31.4, BP 123/82 mmHg, pulse 69 bpm, weight 45 kg. Abdomen is soft with no palpable masses. Assessment: Polycystic ovary syndrome. Plan: a prescription was issued. She was advised to aim for 5% weight loss, exercise 150 minutes a week, and reduce sugary drinks. Follow-up in 3 months.
